summary: Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP filed an 8-K announcing a dropdown acquisition of mineral and royalty interests, plus partnership interests in OGM Partners I and RCPTX, from Rivercrest Capital affiliates. Total consideration is ~$75M cash plus 9.5M Opco common units and an equal number of Class B units exchangeable into Kimbell common units, subject to customary adjustments. The units are issued via Section 4(a)(2) private placement. No board recommendation or advisor named. The deal expands Kimbell's mineral portfolio. Watch for registration of the exchangeable units and any regulatory filings.
